Sandbox_SHAW_Debug_tooltip: Print H:AW trait decisions to the console. Noisy, for testing only.
Sandbox_SHAW_EnableEpileptic_tooltip: Turn the Epileptic trait's effects on or off. The trait can still be picked at character creation either way.
Sandbox_SHAW_EnableNarcoleptic_tooltip: Turn the Narcoleptic trait's effects on or off. The trait can still be picked at character creation either way.
Sandbox_SHAW_EnableDepressive_tooltip: Turn the Depressive trait's effects on or off. The trait can still be picked at character creation either way.
Sandbox_SHAW_EnableImmunocompromised_too: Turn the Immunocompromised trait's effects on or off. The trait can still be picked at character creation either way.
Sandbox_SHAW_EnableEhlersDanlos_tooltip: Turn the Ehlers-Danlos Syndrome trait's effects on or off. The trait can still be picked at character creation either way.
Sandbox_SHAW_EnableNeuralgia_tooltip: Turn the Neuralgia trait's effects on or off. The trait can still be picked at character creation either way.
Sandbox_SHAW_EnableTourette_tooltip: Turn the Tourette's trait's effects on or off. The trait can still be picked at character creation either way.
Sandbox_SHAW_EnableArthritis_tooltip: Turn the Osteoarthritis trait's effects on or off. The trait can still be picked at character creation either way.
Sandbox_SHAW_EnableADHD_tooltip: Turn the ADHD trait's effects on or off. The trait can still be picked at character creation either way.
Sandbox_SHAW_EnableColorBlind_tooltip: Turn the Colour Blind trait's effects on or off. The trait can still be picked at character creation either way.
Sandbox_SHAW_EpilepsyCooldown_tooltip: Minimum in-game hours before another seizure can trigger, however bad conditions get.
Sandbox_SHAW_EpilepsyDuration_tooltip: How long the character is helpless. The design bible says 15-20 seconds.
Sandbox_SHAW_NarcolepsyMinHours_tooltip: Shortest in-game gap between sleep attacks, before fatigue and heavy meals shorten it further.
Sandbox_SHAW_NarcolepsyMaxHours_tooltip: Longest in-game gap between sleep attacks. Must be above the shortest gap.
Sandbox_SHAW_NarcolepsyDuration_tooltip: How long the character is asleep. Real seconds, so it does not shift with day length. Damage still wakes them.
Sandbox_SHAW_NeuralgiaMinMinutes_tooltip: Shortest in-game gap between pain spikes. The bible suggests 10-40 minutes.
Sandbox_SHAW_NeuralgiaMaxMinutes_tooltip: Longest in-game gap between pain spikes. Must be above the shortest gap.
Sandbox_SHAW_TouretteMinMinutes_tooltip: Shortest in-game gap between vocal tics, before stress makes them more frequent.
Sandbox_SHAW_TouretteMaxMinutes_tooltip: Longest in-game gap between vocal tics. Must be above the shortest gap.
Sandbox_SHAW_TouretteRadius_tooltip: How far a vocal tic carries. The bible says 15-20 tiles, the same as a human shout.
Sandbox_SHAW_ApathyChance_tooltip: Chance that a swing simply does not happen, at maximum depression. Scales down as depression falls.
Sandbox_SHAW_ADHDReadingPercent_tooltip: How long reading takes, as a percentage of normal. 300 means three times as long.
Sandbox_SHAW_ADHDFocusMultiplier_tooltip: XP multiplier on the one skill currently in hyperfocus. The bible says 15.
Sandbox_SHAW_ADHDFocusHours_tooltip: In-game hours the hyperfocus stays on one skill before rolling another.
Sandbox_SHAW_ADHDStressThreshold: ADHD: stress level that blocks actions
Sandbox_SHAW_ADHDStressThreshold_tooltip: Stress moodle level (0-4) at which the character refuses to read, wait or sleep. 4 disables the refusal.
Sandbox_SHAW_EDSTripChance_tooltip: Chance per sprinting spell that a leg cramps severely. Rolled once per continuous sprint, not per frame.
Sandbox_SHAW_ColorBlindStrength_tooltip: How grey the world goes. 100 is fully greyscale. Single player only - see the README.
